translation:
Avalokiteśvara, great treasure of non-referential compassion,
Mañjughoṣa, lord of stainless wisdom,
Guhyapati, who subdues the entire host of Māras,
Tsongkhapa, crown jewel of the scholars of the Land of Snows,
At the feet of Lobsang Drakpa, I offer my prayer.
style_instruction: Translate this Tibetan verse of praise line by line: render each Tibetan line as one line of the target language, in the same order, and keep the same number of lines as the source. Devotional but clear register. Keep mantra syllables and proper names in transliteration rather than translating them. Do not add commentary, notes, or explanation.
context: Work: བློ་སྦྱོང་ཚིག་བརྒྱད་མ། (author: གླང་རི་ཐང་པ།). A canonical Tibetan text; the blocks below are being translated one at a time, in order.
